title: Trusted Domains
description: Shape of data/trusted_domains.json, the human-curated, frozen outbound-link-vetting allowlist scripts/check_outbound_links.py enforces. This schema exists so the one persisted data/ artifact that previously had no schemas/*.schema.json counterpart is validated like everything else (per CLAUDE.md's schema conventions) -- it validates *shape only*; the file's contents remain human-curated and frozen (its own _meta.curation field), and any diff touching it still hard-fails the outbound-link CI gate regardless of schema validity.

_meta.description: Human-written provenance/curation notes. description and curation are load-bearing (check_outbound_links.py's frozen-file guard cites _meta.curation); additional prose note fields may be added by a human curator without a schema change.

hostnames.description: Exact-match trusted hostnames (lowercase; check_outbound_links.py's own matching is www.-insensitive, so a www. entry is allowed but redundant). Never a bare multi-tenant host like github.com/huggingface.co -- those belong in path_scoped[].

path_scoped.description: Multi-tenant hosts trusted only under an explicit path prefix (e.g. huggingface.co/moonshotai/).
